batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b K Santokie

batting.name: GJ Bailey
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b P Kumar

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b R Dhawan

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Sandeep Sharma b BE Hendricks

balls.text: into the blockhole, and it's driven to mid-off
bowled! that's another slower ball, which crashes into the stumps as Hendricks takes a big back-and-across step and swings across the line.
low full-toss on the stumps, pushed to cover. The throw went to the keeper's end, where the batsman was comfortably home
another slower ball, outside off, and that bottom-handed shovel-sweep goes high in the air and drops into Rayudu's hands at deep midwicket
that's another full-toss, and Bailey didn't seem to time it at all, but it sails over the bowler's head and comfortably clears the boundary.
slower ball, it ends up as a full toss outside off, and Rishi slaps it to the sweeper
slower ball again, but it's short, and Bailey has all the time in the world to go deep in his crease and pull that over square leg
couple of steps down the pitch, pushes this length ball down to long-off

that is really well played. Made it looked much simpler than it must have been. That was full and wide of off stump, and he's walked across and lapped it over the stumps and well out of range of short fine leg
slower ball again, chipped to long-off.
slower ball, and Bailey inside-edges this attempted cover drive onto his pads. He's struggling to time the ball
that's a terrible delivery. Drags this short and down the leg side, and Tare can't collect cleanly
full and angled into the pads, almost in the blockhole, heaved to long-on
you're a lucky man, Mr. Bailey. That's full, outside off, and Bailey makes room to drive through cover, gets a thick edge past the keeper
full, outside off, Bailey can't get hold of this drive, goes straight to cover. Rohit throws at the stumps, misses, direct hit would have beaten Bailey's dive
slower ball, outside off, swept (?) to long-on
slower ball, outside off, and Bailey doesn't quite time his slog across the line, streaks away towards deep square leg
wide of the crease, angled in towards the top of off stump, Rishi opens his face and pushes it behind point
down the pitch, gets inside the line, and lofts it over cover. Doesn't get too much behind it, and it bounces down to Lendl Simmons on the boundary
full-toss on the stumps, and Bailey flicks it to wide long-on. He wanted two, but Rishi sent him back
back of a length again, outside off again, and Rishi slaps it in front of point
back of a length, outside off, and it keeps a little low. Rishi squirts it towards point.
short, outside off, and Rishi has timed this pull beautifully in front of square. Deep midwicket had no chance, running left.
whoops. Soft dismissal? That's a full toss, and Patel has popped that straight to cover. They're checking for height, and it's......... just under the waist. That's out.
that's an extremely slow slower ball, and Bailey waits an age before cutting it, off the front foot, to point
short and wide, and Bailey cuts this hard, past the right hand of a diving point fielder
slower ball, flicked towards square leg from outside off
lovely shot. It's angled into the pads and full, and Akshar twirls his wrists to pick it up over midwicket
slower ball again, comes back into Patel a touch, and he defends it back to the bowler
slower ball, outside off, and Patel tries to cut but can only chop it onto the pitch
angled in, cramps Akshar for room, tucks it towards square leg for a quick single
back of a length ball, Bailey cuts off the front foot to the off-side sweeper

direct hit! Saha swings hard at this full ball, but doesn't time it. Rayudu ran in from mid-on and sent in a flat, powerful throw that hit the base of the stumps at the bowler's end with Saha well short of the crease
fuller, angled towards the pads, pushed to long-on
good ball, that! might have straightened a touch (which doesn't change the inward angle all that much), and Bailey is beaten trying to poke it towards point
typical Bumrah delivery, angled in from wide of the crease, and Bailey is beaten trying to cut
short and outside off, Saha can't time this cut, and Rayudu stops it again
flat and into Bailey's pads, flicked to deep backward square leg
Rayudu is made to work again as Bailey cuts to his right
slower this time, and Bailey looks to push it towards long-on but Ojha runs across to stop it
short and wide, Bailey cuts, and Rayudu makes a good stop, scrambling to his right at point
sees Bailey down the pitch, pushes it towards his pads, flicked towards deep square leg
lovely flight. Saha is down the track but doesn't get to the pitch. It's a googly, and he pushes it back to the bowler
a touch short, and he rocks back to cut to the sweeper
Bailey is drawn forward by the flight, and was possibly looking to play it towards cover, but it goes with the angle, hits the inside half of his bat, and trickles into the leg side
slow and loopy again, goes with the angle. Bailey is well forward to defend
that's some exaggerated flight. Saha presses forward and drives to deep cover
tossed up again, and Saha wristily pushes it back to the bowler
goes back to cut, but doesn't have either the time or the room. Chops it down into the off side instead
why are they appealing for this? It's angled well down the leg side, and Bailey is probably playing for turn. He gets an inside edge onto the front pad
angles down the leg side once more, and Saha tickles it off his pads, very fine. Short fine leg runs across to cut it off
tossed up again, goes with the arm, and hits Saha high on the bat as he defends
tossed up, towards middle, and Saha stretches out to paddle it fine
down the leg side, and Bailey comes forward to flick towards midwicket
Mohali goes silent! slow, loopy wrong-un, and Maxwell probably picked it but played too early at it, and across it. Gets a thickish leading edge that loops straight back to the bowler.
did that stop on him? It was the googly, and Bailey seemed surprised by that, pops it up towards mid-off, but it drops short of him
bowled 'im! That's a little bit slower, and Vohra slogs across the line and misses. Shreyas lets out a yell as it crashes into the top of middle
that's a shocking delivery, flat and short and heading way down the leg side. Vohra misses out on it, hits it straight to short fine leg
Vohra comes down the track, doesn't get hold of it, goes down to long-on on the bounce. Pollard's throw to the bowler misses everyone, and they run an overthrow
fires this down the leg side
on the pads this time, and Maxwell opens up a touch to push it to long-on with a straight bat
slower ball again, wide outside off, and Maxwell pushes it to point
another slower ball, and Vohra shovels this towards long-on
slower ball, clipped towards midwicket
he's picked him out! Slower ball, and Marsh hit it effortlessly, a touch too effortlessly, perhaps, straight to Pollard at long-on. He might not have picked that change of pace
angles this into Marsh's pads, and he flicks it between deep midwicket and long-on
drops a touch short again, but this hurries towards Marsh, doesn't give him time for the pull that he's shaping for. He knocks it down instead to long-on
down the pitch, and he gets into the perfect position to loft that high and straight
slower, fuller, and on the pads. Marsh flicks it towards deep square leg
this is flat and short, and there's only one place that's going. Marsh rocks back and pulls it powerfully in front of deep midwicket

ooh, what's this? Vohra hits that hard, back down the ground, and it smashes into the stumps at the bowler's end. Dharmasena goes up to the third umpire, but it didn't look like Shreyas got a touch with his fingers as he dived. It passes quite close to the forefinger of his right hand, but there's too much doubt, and it's given not out.
slides down leg, with the angle, hits Vohra on the pads
down the leg side again, and Marsh tickles it off his pads, very fine, and it runs away quickly to the boundary
a bit more air this time, and Marsh clears that front pad and swats it over midwicket, two bounces and over the ropes
short and flat, and Vohra pulls it to long-on
fired down the leg side, and the umpire's arms shoot out even as Aditya Tare goes up in a loud appeal for caught behind
onto Marsh's pads, and it's flicked to deep backward square
this one's quite slow, too, and Vohra goes back to clip it off his hips towards square leg
tossed up a bit, and Vohra defends off the front foot
better this time. Hangs in the air a bit before turning away from Marsh, who gets a leading edge down to long-off
that's the googly, but it's short and wide, and Marsh cuts it to deep cover
back of a length, Vohra goes deep in his crease and tucks that to deep midwicket
short and wide, and Vohra opens his bat face to slice it behind point
that's short, and Vohra's quickly back in his crease, but it's the googly, and it hurries into him and hits his pad, but well outside off
tucked towards midwicket off the pads
massive! Marsh clears his front leg, gets down on one knee, and slog-sweeps way over deep midwicket
Marsh goes across with his front foot, tucks it to square leg
short again. Marsh is a little late on that flick-pull, and it rolls to square leg
this is short, and it's down the leg side
down the pitch, clipped to midwicket
tucked off the pads towards midwicket
short, and Vohra's quickly back to pull this over long-on.
that's short, and it's pulled to deep midwicket from just outside off
back of a length, outside off, 129.2kph, but looked a lot slower, and Vohra waits and waits before defending back down the pitch
comes down the track, PK pulls his length back a bit, and Vohra defends towards cover
short and wide, with a bit of outswing, and Vohra flashes and misses

this one nips back in, and Vohra is hit on the pad as he tries to flick it. Was falling over a touch. But the ball was probably going over the stumps, which explains Dharmasena's lack of interest when PK appeals
length ball, outside off, pushed towards cover
tucked off the pads towards midwicket
that's full, and Vohra throws his bat at it. He's leaning back a bit, and gets a thick outside edge to the third man boundary
good short ball, follows Vohra, and he misses as he tries to ramp it over the keeper
outswinging full toss outside off. Vohra pokes and misses

was he trying to pull that? It was short and outside off, and he was probably looking to hit it over midwicket, but it came on a bit quicker than he expected and it goes off the bottom half of his bat, over a leaping mid-off. Lucky boy.
angled in, back of a length, outside off, left alone
onto the pads again, but a bit of swing away from Marsh, who gets a soft leading edge that drops harmlessly next to him
leg-stumpish, length ball, clipped towards midwicket
Vohra walks across his stumps, out of his crease, and tucks it off his pads to deep backward square leg
this is another outswinger, wider this time, and Vohra's beaten, trying to steer that with half a bat
outswinger, outside off. Vohra pokes and misses

oh man. That's such an unfortunate dismissal. The ball comes in off the seam, tucks Sehwag up. He pushes it down the ground, towards mid-on (or so he thinks) and both batsmen set off. The ball stops right next to the bowler, though, after hitting Vohra's foot, and PK only has to run back two yards to knock the bails off
full and wide, and Sehwag seemed to hit that extremely well, so it was a little strange to watch it go to deep cover on the bounce
tries to slog this across the line, hits him on the front pad, outside leg, and bounces away into the off side
another slower one, outside off, but Sehwag has seen it early. Waits an age before launching it back over the bowler's head
slower ball, outside off, and Sehwag is beaten as he pokes at it
back of a length, tucked into the leg side
wide and full, and Vohra leans elegantly over that, bends at the front knee, and caresses it through cover
length ball, outside off, Sehwag opens his bat face and pushes it towards point
he missed out on that. It was short and wide, and he hit it straight to point
comes in a touch from outside off, just back of a length, Sehwag defends from the crease
uh oh. Praveen doesn't seem to be in rhythm. This slides down the leg side. No real swing either.
this straightened from off stump, and Sehwag checks his shot to push it towards cover
whoa. What a start. This is wide outside off again, and full, and Sehwag swings merrily through the line to send it soaring over extra cover.
that's short and wide outside off, and Sehwag steers it past, no, through backward point. Kieron Pollard dived to his right but couldn't cut it off.
He has the license to go hard now, and he does just that. It's full, floated up into his hitting zone, and he swings it way over long-on.
there it is! It's on the pads again, and he clips it to deep midwicket. Jumps up to complete the single, before punching gloves with Pollard.
full. Low full-toss, and he pushes it to mid-off
onto the pads, flicked down to deep square leg
tossed up, onto the stumps, driven to short midwicket
tossed up, full, Simmons flicks it to wide long-on. Pollard wanted the second, but Simmons sent him back.
walks down the pitch once more. This is angled down leg, and Pollard is looking to get out of the way and get the wide, but it clips his thigh pad
down the pitch, a bit of bounce, and Pollard takes his bottom hand off to defend into the leg side
angled in and full, Simmons chips it down to long-on
down the pitch, flicks it between deep square leg and deep midwicket

that's such a soft dismissal. it's banged in, and Rohit had given himself room. He looks to ramp it and gets it off the middle of his bat, but it drops into Sandy's hands at third man. Was he looking to hit that a bit finer?
this was short, angling down leg again, and Simmons pulls it to deep backward square leg
He's struggled with these shifts in angle, and his first ball slides well wide of leg stump
clears his front leg, hits his hard down the ground, along the ground, but Shivam's hand is in the way. He took a painful blow, there.
down the pitch, gets too close to the pitch, hits it hard to long-on
short, and Rohit pulls uppishly but on the bounce to deep midwicket
down the pitch, it's a high full-toss, and he hits it to deep midwicket. Didn't quite time it.
angled across Simmons, who pushes it to cover off the back foot
tucked away to deep midwicket for the strolled single
that's a very slow slower ball, and Rohit waits before angling his bat face to dab it to third man
short and wide again, but Rohit's square cut finds point this time
slower ball, outside off, Simmons leans forward and plays a checked drive to deep cover
slower ball, angled towards leg and middle, pulled to deep midwicket
short, not too wide, but wide enough for Rohit to cut witheringly past point
full, on off stump, pushed to cover
down the leg side, and Saha collects neatly down the leg side and has the bails off in a flash. Such a good keeper, he is. But Simmons was in no danger.
that's full and outside leg stump. Rohit had given himself a lot of room, and he drives it to sweeper cover
slower ball, but it's short. Rohit waits, adjusts his feet to open up slightly, and pulls it powerfully over midwicket
full, on the pads, pushed down the ground towards long-on. Sandy runs back to field it.
full, onto the pads, flicked to deep midwicket, tyrns back for the second and beats the throw to the keeper. Into the nineties now
down the pitch, gives himself a lot of room. Sandy bowls it on the stumps, and Simmons has a lot of room to swing his bat through the line and launch it onto the sightscreen
comes forward, drives it to cover

he was looking to premeditate here. Don't know what he was trying, really. Stuck his front foot out towards square leg, but moved it back to an orthodox position when he saw the stump-to-stump ball and tucked it carefully into the leg side
fuller this time, and Rohit drives it to long-off
stump-to-stump leg-cutter again. He doesn't really get any movement on these, though. Batsman defends back to the bowler.
another of those slower leg-cutters, on the stumps. Defended off the front foot
slower ball on the stumps, takes a long time to get to the batsman, who pushes it to long-on with a straight bat
angles this into the pads, flicked behind square leg
sees Simmons skip down the pitch and fires it into his pads. Simmons pushes it back to the bowler, who throws hard to the keeper, but the batsman is back in his crease
slower, tossed up, Rohit comes forward and plays a checked drive to the sweeper
this one is fired down leg. Rohit tries to lap it, and misses
Rohit dabs it behind point again, no single again
angled in, goes with the arm. Rohit dabs it behind point, looks for the single, is sent back
back of a length, pushed to cover
full and straight, defended back to the bowler
lets that come onto him and dabs it to third man. He didn't even move his bat there. Just angled it and let the ball hit it
He's gone! slower ball outside off, and Rayudu looks to give himself room and hit it over cover. Doesn't get the elevation, and hits it straight to Sehwag, at chest-height
slower ball, on the stumps, chipped straight back over the bowler
closer to off stump this time, and he opens his face to dab it behind point
Simmons has more width this time, and you don't give him that. That's cut with tremendous bat-speed, and third man has no chance, even though he didn't have too far to run
back of a length, outside off, beaten trying to cut
slower ball, shortish, outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
short ball, dug in this time, and Rayudu is beaten trying to hook. That's one for the over, the umpire signals
short and wide again, and Rayudu cuts hard past point. Maxwell makes a super tumbling stop, running left from deep cover, before Marsh completed the fielding effort
short, angled in, Rayudu bunts it down to third man with an open bat-face
slower ball, short and wide, and it's cut to deep point
back of a length, angled in, and Rayudu jams that down, and it almost rolls onto the stumps
cut hard to the sweeper, Manan Vohra, who has to run hard to his left and dive to stop that
that's wide of off stump. Simmons shapes to sweep, then changes his shot to what looks like an attempted dab to third man, is beaten
down the track, hit hard down the ground. The bowler gets his left hand out to take some pace off the ball
slogged hard, along the ground, to deep midwicket
Simmons takes one step down the pitch, gets low on one knee, and clouts that way over wide long-on
tossed up, and Rayudu has to fetch this slog-sweep from way outside off, to deep midwicket
flat, angled into the stumps, and Simmons defends carefully off the front foot
down the pitch, pushed with a straight bat to wide long-off
short and wide, cut to deep cover point
bit of air, and Simmons clears his front leg and flat-bats it brutally over the bowler's head
comes forward and eases it to deep extra cover
angled in towards the pads, and that's flicked over midwicket. Sandeep Sharma runs to his right from long-on and makes a good diving stop on the boundary
full, almost in the blockhole, driven to wide mid-on
turns in from outside off. Rayudu waited and chopped it to short third man
on the pads, and flicked towards square leg
comes forward to this wide, full ball, and lofts it over cover. One bounce down to the man on the boundary
tries to lap that, but doesn't quite get it off the middle, rolls down to short fine leg
that isn't too short, and it isn't wide, but he's back in a flash to cut that behind square. Races away to the boundary
bowled him! that turned and skidded through. Hussey tried to work it across the line and missed. Hit the top of off stump.
defended into the off side from the crease
angled across Hussey, who times his reverse-sweep well but finds short third man
goes with the angle towards off stump, and Simmons comes forward to tap it towards point
comes forward and is probably looking towards the cover region, gets an outside edge that streaks away past short third man
slow, tossed-up, onto the pads, and Hussey is happy to get away from strike with a little nudge down to deep square leg
angled across, and that's pretty much been Hussey's only run-scoring zone so far, the steer down to third man
onto the pads, but Hussey can't connect as he tries to flick. His the pad and pops up into the off side
better line now. In towards off stump, back of a length, and Simmons reaches his fifty with a quick single to cover. Ran that pretty quickly, so his ankle must be okay.
once again, he's angled it into Simmons' hips, and he flicks it up and over short fine leg

angled onto the hips, not a great idea when fine leg is in the circle. He tucks it past that fielder, but deep square leg runs around and stops it. Uh oh. What happened there? Simmons pulled up after completing his first run, and hopped all the way while running his second. He seems in pain here. He's holding his right ankle.
Angled across Hussey, length ball, steered to third man
on the pads, and Hussey nudges it off them to deep square leg
swept to square leg. Was a bit too full to really get hold of that shot
the umpire is sent ducking, Simmons flat-bats this length ball hard and straight.
makes room again, and cuts from a middle-stump line. Point throws himself to his left to stop that
gives himself a bit of room this time, and places the cut perfectly past point
back of a length, punched to cover
angled in, straightened away a touch, and Simmons steers it to third man
that's short and wide and rising. Simmons has no chance of connecting, so he pulls out of his slash, and Saha takes it high above his head. Not called wide, but looked close.
change of angle hasn't worked. Bad ball. Drops it short, and Simmons pulls it over square leg.
width this time, and Simmons had no need to make room to play his favourite flat-bat slash over the off side. Sliced over point this time.
he tried to make room here, and Beuran saw that and bowled a bouncer outside off. Beats Simmons' slash, it was out of his reach anyway, and the umpire calls a wide
gives himself room, lifts this over cover from outside leg stump, goes bouncing down to the boundary
length ball on the stumps, driven with a straight bat to wide mid-on.
short, angled down leg, but Simmons is into his pull too early. It hits the back of his bat and ricochets off his gloves into the point area

lucky break for Simmons. it was banged in, outside off, and it rose quite high. Simmons tried to pull and top edged it high but safe, towards the third man boundary, where Beuran slides to pull the ball back just short of the ropes.
tries to cut, not much room for that shot, gets it off the outside half of his bat down to third man
length ball, angled across towards middle-and-off, and Hussey defends from the crease
into the pads this time, and Simmons walks a single after flicking to deep square leg
he had brought third man in and pushed point back, and he bowls it short and wide. Simmons cuts hard and late and it flies away into the gap
back of a length, not much room, steered to third man off the back foot
angled towards off stump, Lendl comes forward and plays a punchy drive to cover
rises from back of a length, Simmons is on his toes to defend
short, rising ball outside off, Hussey dabs it down to third man
comes back in sharply from back of a length, and cuts Hussey in half (not literally) as he tries to chop it to point
slides down the leg side, and it hits Saha's right glove as he threw himself sideways
into the blockhole, Hussey defends it into the off side
this is timed through extra cover! Loose start for Kings XI. Simmons stays in the crease and punches it on the up through the tiny gap
enough of staying in the crease! He steps out and flat-bats the length delivery past a diving mid-on fielder. The man there did get a hand to it, but that had too much force on it
back of length, this is punched off the back foot, straight to the cover fielder
here comes the big inswinger, surprises the batsman who was stuck on the crease, tucked to midwicket
this one swings down the leg side and is duly called a wide
easy pickings for Simmons! He doesn't move his feet but he doesn't need to. It's a gentle-paced loosener wide outside off and he hammers it through covers
length delivery wide outside off, Simmons throws his bat at that but finds the fielder at point. Not a great ball to start
